subject: [AMBER] CHAMBER prmtops cannot be used with NMODE

messages.author: 周丽萍
messages.body:
When I ran NMODE entropy calculation in MMPBSA.py for a CHAMBER prmtop, I got an error says,
"CHAMBER prmtops cannot be used with NMODE".
Is there a way to do NMODE or other methods to calculation entropy for a CHAMBER prmtop(charmm force field)?
